project.description: This secondary data analysis project will analyze deidentified data from 48,218 participants from eight studies and the publicly available NHANES cohorts (wrist NHANES 2011-2014; hip/counts-NHANES 2003-2006). The studies include (i) the RISE Study, (ii) the SOL-VIDA Study, (iii) the iWATCH Study, (iv) the MOCA Study, (v) the PHASE Study, (vi) the AusDiab Study, (vii) the ACT Study, and (viii) the WHISH accelerometer sub-study. The final dataset of data from the RISE study, the iWATCH study, and NHANES cohorts will be de-identified. It will be deposited into the UC San Diego Library Data repository along with study protocols, code, and models for public use. De-identified data will be available after the main outcome papers are published.
